description: This file contains partial class implementations and extension methods related to Kubernetes hosting support within the Orleans framework. It defines extension methods for configuring Kubernetes hosting in the Orleans silo builder and service collection, as well as classes representing a Kubernetes cluster agent and hosting options, including environment variable constants and configuration properties.

classes.name: KubernetesClusterAgent
classes.description: Represents a cluster agent managing Kubernetes interactions and lifecycle participation within Orleans silos.

classes.name: KubernetesHostingOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for Kubernetes hosting, including environment variable names and retry policies.

methods.name: UseKubernetesHosting
methods.description: Extension methods to add Kubernetes hosting support to IServiceCollection and ISiloBuilder, with optional configuration.

methods.name: KubernetesClusterAgent.OnStop
methods.description: Handles cleanup or shutdown processes for the Kubernetes cluster agent.
